pages.text: $(bold)BetterEnd$() turns the outer islands into full biomes with Thallasium, Terminite and Aeternium gear. YUNG's Better End Island rebuilds the main island. Moog's End Structures and the reworked End Cities.

$(bold)Elytra$(): wear it in the Elytra Slot so you keep your chestplate.$(br)$(bold)Ender's Delight$(): End cooking.$(br)$(bold)Enderdragon Loot$(): the dragon drops much more than vanilla.$(br2)Every first kill pays double. Kill every boss once before you farm any of them.
